top_problems: Restaurant managers spend 4-6 hours a week rebuilding rotas after last-minute call-offs
Staff swap shifts in group chats, so the manager finds out at clock-in
Overtime costs spike when no-shows are covered by whoever is already on site
existing_alternatives: Paper rota on the back-office wall
Generic scheduling apps without swap approval

customer_segments.target: Independent restaurants with 15-60 hourly staff in UK cities
early_adopters_named: Manager at a 3-site burger group who built a swap spreadsheet
Owner of a 40-cover bistro who pays a manager to rebuild the rota every Sunday
Ops lead at a 5-site pizza chain tracking call-offs in a shared Google Sheet
Owner of a 25-staff cafe who texts every swap approval by hand
GM at a hotel restaurant whose agency overtime bill doubled in 2025

unique_value_proposition.statement: Independent restaurant managers stop rebuilding rotas: staff swap shifts in the app and you approve in one tap

features: Swap requests with one-tap manager approval
Call-off alert that offers the shift to qualified staff first

channels.name: Restaurant owner Facebook groups
channels.test_plan: Post the swap-spreadsheet story in 5 groups; target 30 demo requests in 4 weeks

channels.name: EPOS reseller referrals
channels.test_plan: Two resellers pilot with 10 sites each

revenue_streams.first_10k_mrr_plan: 127 sites: 60 from groups, 67 from two resellers by month 9

key_metrics.north_star: Shifts swapped without manager rework per week

unfair_advantage.plan_to_build: Exclusive integration with the two largest UK hospitality EPOS resellers

assumptions.statement: Managers will move swaps out of WhatsApp
Resellers will refer for a 20% first-year share
